items.name: Gold
items.description: Most commonly used form of currency

items.name: Arrows
items.description: Arrows are used with a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack. Each time you attack with the weapon, you expend one piece of ammunition.

items.name: Healing Potion (Common)
items.description: You regain hit points when you drink this potion. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

items.name: Amulet Of Health
items.description: Your Constitution Modifier is 4 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on you if your Constitution Modifier is already 4 or higher.

items.name: Belt Of Hill Giant Strength
items.description: Your Strength Modifier is 5 while you wear this belt. It has no effect on you if your Strength Modifier is already 5 or higher.

items.name: Birthright
items.description: While wearing the hat, it increases your charisma modifier by 1.

items.name: Braces Of Defence
items.description: While wearing these bracers, you gain a +2 bonus to AC if you are wearing no armor and using no shield.

items.name: Flame Tongue
items.description: You can use a bonus action to speak this magic sword's command word, causing flames to erupt from the blade. These flames shed bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet. While the sword is ablaze, it deals an extra 2d6 fire damage to any target it hits. The flames last until you use a bonus action to speak the command word again or until you drop or sheathe the sword.

items.name: Greataxe
items.description: A melee weapon, sharp on both sides

items.name: Handaxe
items.description: A melee weapon that can be thrown, not recommended for juggling
